Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 blue level 3 Digimon card, or 1 Digimon card with [Seadramon] in its name or with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in one of its traits from 1 of your blue Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
[Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When your opponent plays a Digimon, you may activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects.
